title: Find the reference angle
text: Notice that $$\frac{7\pi}{6}$$ is just past a half-rotation of $$\pi$$ (which is equivalent to $$\frac{6\pi}{6}$$ ). This places the angle in the third quadrant, with a reference angle of $$\frac{\pi}{6}.$$

title: Determine the sign
text: Recall your unit circle. In the third quadrant, both the $$x$$ and $$y$$ coordinates are negative. Since cosine corresponds to the $$x\$\$-coordinate$$, $$our$$ $$final$$ $$answer$$ $$must$$ $$be$$ $$negative$$.

title: Evaluate the special value
text: The $$x\$\$-coordinate$$ $$at$$ $$the$$ $$reference$$ $$angle$$ $$\frac{\pi}{6}$$ is $$\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}.$$ Applying the negative sign for the third quadrant gives $$-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}.$$
